title: PowerPoint on the web: reference a Teams meeting or chat when creating a presentation with Copilot Agent Mode
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, licence assignment path and PowerShell command match the sources. Microsoft documents the user-prompted presentation workflow and the Teams sensitivity-label limitation; the remaining feature-specific gaps were independently searched and confirmed.

claims.claim: Copilot Agent Mode in PowerPoint creates a presentation from a Teams meeting or chat mentioned in the user's prompt.
claims.quote: Users can enter a prompt that mentions the relevant Teams meeting or chat, and Copilot will generate a deck based on that content.

claims.claim: Microsoft's release notes list the feature under July 01, 2026, unlike the March CY2026 roadmap target.
claims.quote:
## July 01, 2026
Reference a Teams meeting or chat when creating a presentation with Agent Mode in PowerPoint [Windows, Web, Mac]

claims.claim: No Microsoft Learn feature page beyond the release-notes entry was found for this capability.
claims.quote: Searched: "PowerPoint" "Teams" "reference" "Agent Mode"; PowerPoint reference Teams meeting chat presentation license Copilot Chat transcript recap matching prompt meter. Opened release-notes feature entry; results gave no other feature page.

claims.where: summary; Why it matters; Risk assessment; Scope; Governance controls; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Copilot only surfaces organisational data the individual user has at least view permissions to, including Teams and file content.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot only surfaces organizational data to which individual users have at least view permissions.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Why it matters; rationale: impact
claims.claim: The capability is user-opt-in: users choose it by referencing a Teams meeting or chat in a prompt.
claims.quote: Enter a prompt that references the Teams meeting or chat you want to use in your presentation. Press Enter. Searched: PowerPoint Agent Mode reference Teams meeting chat admin disable switch Graph PowerShell; no specific switch found.

claims.where: summary; Why it matters; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: No feature-specific admin switch is documented as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: PowerPoint Agent Mode reference Teams meeting chat admin disable switch Graph PowerShell; "PowerPoint" "Agent Mode" admin settings disable. Opened release notes and Copilot privacy page; no feature-specific switch found.

claims.claim: Microsoft names no administrative action for this feature.
claims.quote: Searched: PowerPoint Agent Mode reference Teams meeting chat admin disable switch Graph PowerShell; "PowerPoint" "Agent Mode" admin settings disable. Opened release-notes entry, which provides user steps and no admin action.

claims.claim: Copilot honours user usage rights on data encrypted by Microsoft Purview Information Protection.
claims.quote: When you have data that's encrypted by Microsoft Purview Information Protection, Microsoft Copilot honors the usage rights granted to the user.

claims.claim: Information Protection encryption can be applied through sensitivity labels or restricted permissions.
claims.quote: This encryption can be applied by sensitivity labels or by restricted permissions in apps in Microsoft 365 by using Information Rights Management (IRM).

claims.claim: Copilot does not currently recognize sensitivity labels protecting Teams meetings and chat.
claims.quote: Sensitivity labels that protect Teams meetings and chat aren't currently recognized by Copilot and agents.

claims.claim: Returned meeting-chat or channel-chat data does not display its associated sensitivity label.
claims.quote: data returned from a meeting chat or channel chat won't display an associated sensitivity label

claims.claim: The unrecognized Teams sensitivity label cannot prevent copying returned chat data into a destination item.
claims.quote: copying chat data can't be prevented for a destination item

claims.claim: The sensitivity label on Teams meetings and chat cannot be inherited by the destination.
claims.quote: the sensitivity label can't be inherited

claims.claim: The Teams sensitivity-label limitation does not apply to labelled meeting invites, responses or calendar events.
claims.quote: This limitation doesn't apply to meeting invites, responses, and calendar events that are protected by sensitivity labels.

claims.claim: Microsoft describes no new identity or permission model for this feature.
claims.quote: Searched: "PowerPoint" "Teams" "reference" "Agent Mode"; PowerPoint Agent Mode reference Teams meeting chat admin disable switch Graph PowerShell. Opened feature release notes and Copilot privacy page; no new identity or permission model described.

claims.claim: The release notes instruct the user to enter a prompt and press Enter to create the presentation.
claims.quote: Enter a prompt that references the Teams meeting or chat you want to use in your presentation. Press Enter. Copilot will create a presentation using the referenced Teams content.

claims.claim: No page read describes this referencing feature taking actions outside the presentation.
claims.quote: Searched: "PowerPoint" "Teams" "reference" "Agent Mode"; PowerPoint reference Teams meeting chat presentation license Copilot Chat transcript recap matching prompt meter. Opened feature release notes and Copilot privacy page; no outside-presentation action described for this feature.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not published how the referenced Teams meeting or chat is matched to the prompt.
claims.quote: Searched: PowerPoint reference Teams meeting chat presentation license Copilot Chat transcript recap matching prompt meter; "PowerPoint" "Teams" "reference" "Agent Mode". Opened release-notes entry; it tells users to mention the meeting or chat but gives no matching mechanism.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions
claims.claim: No feature-specific licence rule, including for Copilot Chat users without a Microsoft Copilot licence, is published in the pages checked.
claims.quote: Searched: PowerPoint reference Teams meeting chat presentation license Copilot Chat transcript recap matching prompt meter; "PowerPoint" "Teams chat" "license" "credits". Opened Copilot licensing and release notes; no specific entitlement rule for this referencing feature found.

claims.claim: No separate meter or charge for this referencing feature is published in the licensing page or release-notes entry.
claims.quote: Searched: PowerPoint reference Teams meeting chat presentation license Copilot Chat transcript recap matching prompt meter; "PowerPoint" "Teams chat" "license" "credits". Opened Copilot licensing page and feature release-notes entry; neither names a separate feature meter or charge.

claims.claim: Licence assignment is at Microsoft 365 admin center > Users > Active users > user > Licenses and Apps > Licenses.
claims.quote: go to the Users > Active users page. Select the row of the user that you want to assign a license to. In the right pane, select Licenses and Apps. Expand the Licenses section, select the boxes for the licenses that you want to assign

claims.claim: The documented PowerShell licence assignment call is Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @().
claims.quote:
To assign a license to a user, use the following command in PowerShell.
Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @()

claims.where: controls[0].note; Cost and licensing; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: Assigning licences requires at least License Administrator or User Administrator.
claims.quote: You must be at least a License or User Administrator to assign licenses.

claims.claim: No transcript or recap requirement for referencing a meeting was found.
claims.quote: Searched: "PowerPoint" "Teams meeting" "transcript" presentation reference; PowerPoint reference Teams meeting chat presentation license Copilot Chat transcript recap matching prompt meter. Opened feature release notes; no transcript, recap or other feature-specific prerequisite stated.

claims.claim: The release-notes entry states no feature-specific prerequisite.
claims.quote: Searched: PowerPoint reference Teams meeting chat presentation license Copilot Chat transcript recap matching prompt meter. Opened the full feature entry in release notes; its description and user steps state no feature-specific prerequisite.

claims.claim: Licence assignment is the only availability control the pages checked tie to this web referencing feature.
claims.quote: Searched: PowerPoint Agent Mode reference Teams meeting chat admin disable switch Graph PowerShell. Opened release notes, licensing and privacy pages; found licence assignment but no additional control tied to this feature on the web; privacy-page content-analysis controls name device apps.

claims.claim: The medium cost rating reflects a possible add-on licence for users without the product entitlement.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot is available with Microsoft 365 E7 or as an add-on for eligible commercial, US Government, and education subscription plans.

claims.claim: The user's Teams and file access boundaries are governed by the underlying Microsoft 365 services' permission models.
claims.quote: It's important that you're using the permission models available in Microsoft 365 services, such as SharePoint, to help ensure the right users or groups have the right access to the right content within your organization.

claims.claim: The table's licence assignment control manages general Microsoft Copilot entitlement rather than a separate Teams-reference setting.
